page.overview:
What is Thunder Machine?

Thunder Machine is a vehicle in the Energon Universe G.I. Joe comics from Skybound.

The Thunder Machine is the Dreadnok's vehicle. Specifically belonging to Buzzer and Ripper. Cobra Commander destroys it.
